why: A handles head and range options; B only fetches a byte range.
B checks elapsed time since last modification; C and D are idle-step timeouts in the archiver.
B reads a 2D f32 array from npz; A is the generic helper it calls.
D connects a NATS client with a NATS_URL env fallback; A only reads the env config.
B filters PVs by hash modulo pod count; A is a Redis slot map init.
C and D both open the IB device and set up context; A is the constructor that stores parameters.
C merges Arrow schemas; D pads a batch to a merged schema and A infers fields from data.
C increments the sequence and marks DONE at n_pulses; A is a caller handling counters.
D writes the buffered step and marks it finalized; A only logs a scan end.
B is a WebSocket loop broadcasting updates and handling client commands; A is a NATS live loop, not two-way client connection.
D loads a viz config JSON from Redis by id; others are data/schema cache readers.
All three encode gathered Prometheus metrics to text in different services.
D detects index discontinuity modulo ring capacity; A is a test of a sequence gap counter.
D is the generic typed subscribe; B wraps it and C is a specific tick listener.
B builds a zarr array with chunk shape and fill values; C is a bare HDF5 dataset constructor.
B retries the npz entry with a .npy extension; C is a typed wrapper over it.
D renders the accumulated statistic buffer into display pixels; C calls it and A is a whole update loop.
D is the EMA smoother with tau; C is a different accumulator push and B a test.
D is the feedback step with Kalman filter; the rest are tests and fixtures.
A returns a uniform float in [-0.5,0.5); C is Gaussian.
A uses a Box-Muller transform; D approximates normal by summing uniforms and B uses gauss.
A builds the plugin state packet from measurement, actuator and params; B is default params.
Same event-pattern check in Rust and Python.
B waits for a pulse count DONE signal with timeout; A polls an RDMA CQ.
A and C both compute Redis cluster slot with CRC16, in Rust and Python.
A writes a DataFrame split per run to parquet cache files; others write zarr or lance.
A and B compute the key slot and return the owning connection; C and D only delegate to B.
B, C and D resolve seeds, read CLUSTER SLOTS and open node connections; A only logs topology.
B is the mock put that stores the value and mirrors it to .RBV; A only seeds a motor fixture.
C subscribes to the scan monitor subject and B handles its status messages; D is a legacy ZMQ subscriber setup, A is a mock publisher.
A splits a legacy single parquet cache into per-run files; B deletes old run directories.
D maps the key slot to its node connection; A delegates to an addr lookup, C builds the slot map, B only formats keys.
A collects ZSET members of one second across several events and returns them sorted and unique.
A is a plain moving-mean over a signal; B is a per-pulse smoother with window and EMA modes across pulses.
A fetches a key across nodes and follows MOVED redirects; B pipelines by node and retries once on MOVED.
C replays a recorded timeline through the controller and reports rms error; A simulates synthetically, B evaluates an estimator scan.
B correlates data against each kernel row and returns the normalized square; A is an FFT ensemble score, C and D are constructors.
B is the st.cache_data memoized run list; C is the uncached lister, D memoizes experiments not runs.
A makes worker threads join the main thread CA context; C caches CA channels but not across threads.
C simulates a closed loop with noise and verifies Kalman filtering and rms; the Rust tests each check one aspect via a shared helper.
Both turn {timestamp: {field: value}} into typed columns with first-seen type inference.
C returns count, latest mtime and total size as a directory signature; A and B only sum size.
A is a periodically refreshed fragment showing live metrics and recent tail records; B is a GUI frame update with plots.
A and C are thread functions that read ring buffers and publish monitor messages over sockets; D sends over RDMA, B is a simple ZMQ republisher.
B rounds a size up to an arbitrary alignment; A only aligns to 64.
B sets the count bit for an id in the ring queue and stores the item.
A maps ibv_wr_opcode (work request); B maps work completion opcodes.
B is a monitor thread that polls sockets and coordinates processed calibrated frames; A receives status, C writes stats, D receives EVR.
A and C receive raw frames, sync modules and push via sockets; B receives detector status.
A reads free_hugepages (available); B reads nr_hugepages (total).
C appends detector frame data and metadata chunks to HDF5 datasets; B and D write metadata or waveforms separately to zarr.
